request.operation: link derived-trigger pressure to the committed scheduler trace fix and its regression evidence

outcome.implemented_behavior: The trace reports exact admitted trigger categories for each owner in the wave that scheduled it, including derived events, through the existing incremental coherence mechanism.
outcome.verification_basis: The linked observation records the second-wave family-pass regression fixture and the 170-passed, 21-skipped incremental and capability-intelligence test run.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: Immediate routing and trace behavior are verified; reduced agent burden and later service outcomes remain unmeasured.

pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment incremental coherence scheduler and trace projection
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Carry the exact owner-filtered event set through each scheduling wave and record the admitted trigger categories on that pass.

improvement_relation.basis: The owner router now retains owner-filtered event facts for each wave and writes those facts into the corresponding scheduled pass.
